- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant provided information on passport processing times: Routine Service (6-8 weeks), Expedited Service (2-3 weeks with an additional fee), and Expedited Service at a Regional Passport Agency (same-day or next-day).

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant advised updating the driver's license with the new address and provided steps to do so, including visiting the DMV website, filling out a change of address form, providing required documents, and paying a fee.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Assistant mentioned that the time to update a driver's license with a new address varies by state, with in-person updates typically taking 15-30 minutes to an hour and online or mail-in updates taking 7-10 business days.
